## Summarize Cross-Validation Results {.unnumbered}


### Description

Detailed summary of cross-validation results from <code>cv_masreml()</code>,
including accuracy statistics across folds, regression slope (bias),
and GEBV distribution for all individuals.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>## S3 method for class 'masreml_cv'
summary(object, ...)
</code></pre>
